items: Reviews give your marketing team a steady source of user-generated content and a public place to shape how guests see your brand at every location.
Responding to reviews consistently signals to Google that your brand is engaged, which helps each location get found in local search.
Manage reviews for all locations from one platform so replies stay consistent in tone and speed while saving your team time.
Personalize each reply with details from the review, and pass recurring feedback to operations or local managers so they can fix what guests mention.
